drums.description: Funk-rock instrumental, A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a syncopated 16th-note scratch riff, The electric bass performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking with a dry, punchy drum kit, The drums feature a tight snare and a consistent hi-hat pattern with occasional open accents, A bright, percussive Hammond organ enters with rhythmic stabs, The tempo is 112 BPM in the key of E minor, The arrangement is centered on a repetitive four-bar groove with subtle variations in the bass fills and organ voicing, The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the rhythmic interplay between the guitar and bass Publish

bass.description: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, overdriven electric bass guitar as the lead melodic and rhythmic voice, The bass utilizes a bright, metallic tone with heavy pick attack and distortion, performing a syncopated, descending riff, A drum kit provides a steady backbeat with a crisp snare and consistent eighth-note hi-hat patterns, The arrangement follows a repetitive, riff-based structure with subtle variations in bass intensity and drum fills, The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor, The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the grit of the bass strings and the punch of the kick drum Publish
